heading: This is my story
content: Alright, let's do this one last time...

My name is Karan Bisht, and I’m a full-stack web developer. I thrive on challenges and constantly push myself to improve, as reflected in my academic achievements. My passion for art and music shapes my approach to development, allowing me to infuse creativity into every project.

I believe growth comes from continuous learning and adaptation, which is why I’m always exploring new technologies and refining my skills. For me, web development is more than just code—it's a canvas where I blend technical expertise with artistic expression.
Whether it’s designing visually engaging interfaces or crafting seamless user experiences, I aim to build digital solutions that are both functional and inspiring.

list.caption: Web Development
list.heading: Full-Stack Web Development
list.title: MERN Stack Developer
list.body: Experienced in building scalable and high-performance web applications using the MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) stack. Proficient in designing RESTful APIs, managing databases, and implementing authentication. Skilled in state management, server-side rendering, and optimizing web performance.

list.caption: UI/UX
list.heading: Designing Intuitive and Responsive Web Interfaces
list.title: UI/UX Designer
list.body: Adept at crafting user-centric designs that prioritize usability and accessibility. Skilled in wireframing, prototyping, and implementing responsive layouts using modern frameworks. Focused on delivering seamless user experiences through thoughtful design principles and interactive elements.

list.body: Pursued a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, gaining in-depth knowledge of software development, algorithms, and system architecture.
